scope: Source inspection only; this manifest is not a runtime measurement receipt.

supported_observations: A failed call returns a typed error without panicking the host.
Aggregate results are copied before the Component post-return hook.
Closing an idle handle removes it; nested or active-call close is rejected.
surfaces.boundary: Fuel, store limits, and wire-size checks are rejection budgets, not allocation or retained-memory counters.

supported_observations: The raw registration remains live until native acknowledgement and callback quiescence.
A failed stop is retained as quarantined live state rather than dropped.
surfaces.boundary: Callback phase/status proves lifecycle ordering only; it does not expose a byte counter.

explicit_unknowns: No source-facing guest-root, finalizer, allocator, or peak-retained-memory counter exists at either seam.
No runtime execution receipt is claimed by this static preparation.
Native allocation/retention and Component store accounting must remain separate; values must not be combined.
